summary: Representative Chromium 144 was available, but navigation to the deployed GitHub Pages STT surface was blocked by runtime administration policy before origin execution. Cold and same-context repeat attempts both failed with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR, so CDN/model/cache behavior could not be truthfully measured.

No cache conclusion possible because the first navigation never reached origin/CDN/model assets.
